# Little Pumpkin Design – Jennifer Roob

> Portfolio of Jennifer Roob, Fullstack Web Developer (Frontend & DevOps) and UI/UX Designer
> based in Uedem, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. Unusual T-shaped profile: classically trained
> print designer, over a decade in retail with team and department leadership including her own
> business, then re-trained into software development. Today she architects, secures and
> self-hosts complete web stacks end to end.

## 🧑‍💻 About the Developer
Jennifer Roob's career is deliberately multi-disciplinary. She began in classical print and
graphic design, spent over a decade in retail, customer service and team leadership — including
running her own business and leading a digital-print department — and then re-trained into
software development, graduating as a state-recognized "Certified Web Developer" (ILS) with a
top grade of 1.0.

That combination is the point: the operational and people-leadership strength of a former
department head and business owner, the typographic eye of a trained print designer, and the
engineering skills to build, secure and operate a modern fullstack on her own infrastructure.

## 💼 Current Roles
- **Web Developer (Frontend & DevOps)** at **Wert Eins GmbH** (since 05/2024): Angular/TypeScript
  frontends, headless & enterprise CMS integration (Strapi, Webflow, FirstSpirit, WordPress),
  REST-API integration, CI/CD pipelines and Docker-based environments, plus accessibility work.
- **Founder / Freelancer – Little Pumpkin Design** (since 04/2020): design & web development.

## 🏗️ The Tech Stack (Under the Hood)
This website is not a template or site builder. It is a fully custom, self-hosted architecture:
- **Frontend:** Angular 21 with Server-Side Rendering (SSR) for SEO, performance and hydration.
- **Backend:** Strapi (Headless CMS) with a PostgreSQL database exposing a flexible REST API.
- **Infrastructure & CI/CD:** Self-hosted on a Synology NAS via Docker Compose; deployments
  automated through GitHub Actions and a self-hosted runner.
- **Security:** Hardened Nginx reverse proxy, configured by hand — TLS 1.2/1.3 only, strict
  security headers and a Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonces.
- **AI-assisted engineering:** Uses Claude Code and GitHub Copilot for refactoring and rapid
  prototyping.

## ✨ Highlight Feature: The "Little Pumpkin Net"
A creative and technical highlight is the interactive skills section: instead of standard charts,
a custom-built dynamic SVG simulation. Main technologies act as structural anchor points while
sub-skills dangle beneath them on calculated Bézier curves, wobbling and glowing on interaction —
an example of advanced Angular data-binding applied to creative frontend engineering.

## 🚀 Core Competencies
1. **Frontend Development:** Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, SCSS, Pug,
   custom animations.
2. **Backend & Data:** REST APIs, Strapi CMS, PostgreSQL, PHP (basics); trained in Vue.js & Laravel.
3. **DevOps & Self-Hosting:** Docker & Docker Compose, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines),
   Nginx/reverse proxy configuration, Linux server administration on a Synology NAS.
4. **Design (Digital & Print):** UI/UX, responsive design, corporate identity, typography,
   pre-press/print production, Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
5. **Leadership & Business:** Proven team and department leadership (led a digital-print
   department), self-employed business owner, retail branch management, customer empathy, and a
   certified trainer qualification (AEVO / Ausbilderschein).

## 🎓 Qualifications
- Certified Web Developer (ILS), graded 1.0 (excellent) — HTML/CSS, JavaScript, responsive design,
  Vue.js, server-side technologies, Laravel.
- State-recognized Graphic Designer (ILS), graded 1.2 (very good) — typography, design
  fundamentals, photography, marketing, copyright.
- Trainer aptitude certificate (AEVO / IHK) and Retail Management Assistant (IHK).
- Languages: German (native), English (very good).
